_help: Where To Submit product profile. Replace every value that starts with TODO, or set it to null if it does not apply. Keys that start with _ are notes and are ignored. A text key that ends in a number is a hard limit in characters: tagline60 must be 60 characters or fewer. Never put passwords, API keys or card details in this file. Run scripts/preflight.mjs after editing.
source: TODO: where these facts came from, e.g. homepage, /pricing and JSON-LD read on 2026-11-02, confirmed by the owner

product._help: Facts about the product. name and url are required. url is the root of the product site, not a deep page. categories and tags are your own words; the agent maps them to each site's options live.
product.name: TODO: Product name
categories: TODO: main category, e.g. Developer Tools
audience: TODO: who it is for, e.g. Indie developers

copy._help: Descriptions, one object per language (en is required, add zh, fr ... only if you have real copy for them). Each key is <kind><maxChars>. The agent picks the longest variant that fits a site's limit and only shortens or rephrases; it never adds claims. impartial* variants are third person with no we/our, for sites that ask for neutral text. Add more lengths any time, e.g. short250.

en.short160: TODO: one or two sentences, 160 characters max
en.medium500: TODO: a short paragraph, 500 characters max
en.long1500: TODO: the full description, 1500 characters max
en.impartial160: TODO: neutral third-person summary, 160 characters max
en.impartial500: TODO: neutral third-person paragraph, 500 characters max
en.useCases300: TODO: what people use it for, 300 characters max
en.whyUnique300: TODO: what is different about it, 300 characters max

pricing._help: model is one of: free, freemium, free-trial, paid, open-source, contact. startingPrice is free text such as $9/mo, or null. The agent maps this to each site's pricing dropdown.

assets._help: Paths are relative to this workspace folder. logoSquare is required: PNG or JPEG at least 512x512 and exactly square, or an SVG. logoWide, ogImage (1200x630) and screenshots are optional but many sites ask for them.

contact._help: email is required and is the mailbox the agent must be able to read for confirmation codes and links. submitterName is the name typed into 'Your name' fields; founderName is used when a site asks for the founder or maker.

links._help: Public profiles of the product or company. Full URLs or null. The agent fills these only into matching fields.

accounts._help: Credentials the agent may use when permissions.allowRegistration is true: to register or sign in on directories, and to open the mailbox in the browser to read verification codes and links. They never leave this machine and never go into MCP evidence or reports. Keep .wheretosubmit/ out of git. default: email/password used on every site unless accounts.sites has an entry for that domain; password null means sign in with the Google session already open in the browser (must match the email), otherwise the agent asks you once. mailbox: webmail the agent logs into (url like https://mail.163.com, https://mail.qq.com, https://mail.google.com, https://outlook.live.com); leave email/password null to reuse default; leave the whole thing null to let the agent pick the webmail from the email's domain. sites: per-domain overrides the agent fills in when a site forced a different email or password. username: the submitter's personal handle (e.g. jackwilliam), never the product name; leave null and the agent derives one from contact.submitterName and saves it here.

permissions._help: What the agent may do without asking. allowRegistration: register or sign in on directories with the credentials in accounts (default false); the agent never invents passwords. allowCaptchaHandoff: fill the form and leave the CAPTCHA for you to solve (default true); the agent never solves CAPTCHAs itself. allowPaid: the agent may take a paid listing to the checkout page and hand it to you; it never enters payment details (default false). neverShare: fields the agent must never fill, even if a site requires them; such sites are skipped.

extra._help: Answers the agent had to ask you, saved so it never asks twice. Key is what the form asked, in camelCase. Values are strings, numbers or booleans. Examples: foundedYear, teamSize, headquartersCountry, companyName.
